protocolInterpretation: The preregistered passing-profile rule requires an eligible adaptive profile to stop at least one pixel before max. A finite in-range adaptive cell that reaches max everywhere is a valid measured candidate that fails eligibility, not an invalid experiment input.
permittedCorrection: Separate Sample Count measurement validity from candidate gate passage. Keep finite/range and fixed-control all-max checks as experiment-validity requirements; use early stopping only in the candidate combined-pass decision.
